reply_text: Tobias, the only site named for that incident is **Southgate**. In the #inc-tansley-carrier-api channel from 2025-09-03, Priyanka wrote that label printing had stalled at Tansley Parcel depots and that Southgate dispatch had totes stacked beside door 4. Later she wrote that labels were printing again and Southgate had cleared the backlog. The channel doesn't spell out "depot" next to Southgate, so check that before you give it to the customer. The incident was from September 2025, not this month.
